MONITORING TRUSTEE IN CASE M.10575 – BOUYGUES / EQUANS


On 22 July 2022 the Commission approved the appointment of:

                   Alcis Advisers GmbH
                   Fasanenstr. 73
               10719 Berlin
              Germany

                  Contact: David Cayet
                  david.cayet@alcis-advisers.com


as Monitoring Trustee in the above-mentioned case.


The role of the Monitoring Trustee is to monitor the compliance of Bouygues with the
Commitments attached to the Commission's Decision of 19 July 2022 and to report to the
Commission thereon.

Third parties who have queries in relation to the Commitments may contact the Trustee
through the above contact details.

The foregoing  is without prejudice to the Commission's jurisdiction to oversee the
implementation of the Commitments attached to its Decision.
